system.description:
Also, at 3rd level, as a bonus action on your turn or when you would cast a Jutsu granted by the Mobile Savant class feature, you can enter an enhanced state of speed and reflexes called your Flash state for 1 minute, or until you would use a feature or ability that would cause it to end early.

You can end your Flash state early by utilizing one of two special actions called Speed Blitz or Burst Rush.

Speed Blitz. As part of one of the attacks granted by the attack action, you can make an unarmed or weapon attack that gains the benefits of Jack of All: Combat. This attack cannot be reacted to.

Burst Rush. When you take the Dash action, select a space you can see within your movement speed range. You teleport to this space. If you began your turn next to a willing allied creature they can teleport with you, ending the teleport in a space within 5 feet of you, that can hold them.

| #### Flash / Reflex Amp / Your movement speed is increased by +10. / You gain a Rank of Mastery to Dexterity based checks. / You gain a +1 bonus to your Dexterity saving throws and your AC. This increases to +2 at 9th level. |
